    Zurück 14.  bis  15. November 2026
             Ort: Messe Karlsruhe One arena. Thousands of ravers.
  
  And a world premiere behind the decks. FANTASM B2B KLOFAMA B2B WINSON
  
  ALL NIGHT LONG. On November 14, HASARDEUR takes over dm-arena Karlsruhe for a world premiere built to push production, sound and energy beyond anything we have done before. FANTASM B2B KLOFAMA B2B WINSON all night long — a first edition created with one intention: to become one of those nights people will still talk about years from now.
